show.description: On her wedding day, small-town waitress Tanvi is betrayed by her groom and best friend. Humiliated, she collapses—only to be saved by Rehan, a charming ambulance driver. In a bold act of defiance, she asks him to marry her on the spot. But Tanvi doesn’t know Rehan is secretly a billionaire heir, hiding his identity to escape his father and honor his mother’s values.
